page.overview:
Who is Data Twins?

The Data Twins are members of the Coalition of Planets responsible for analyzing their data.

The twins are grey humanoid aliens, one is thin, the second is overweight, both have enlarged heads, and are supplied to a blue wire when sitting on chairs, they wear blue short shirts and shorts.

The twins exhibit a certain level of arrogance, as they would reprimand Coalition agents for errors made during their missions.

The twins have spent years with the Coalition of Planets, demonstrating unwavering commitment to the mission of stopping the Viltrum Empire's efforts for good. They oversee the data records of all Coalition agents.
